questionText: Which was the first and most immediate challenge faced by independent India among the three core nation-building challenges outlined in NCERT?

options.text: Shaping a united nation that was accommodating of the immense diversity of the country
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Identifies the first challenge of nation building as unity amidst diversity.

options.text: Building an intercontinental ballistic missile defense shield
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option 'Building an intercontinental ballistic missile defense shield'. Confuses the exact sequence of historical treaties, elections, or political accords.

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option 'Conquering neighbouring territories across the Indian Ocean'. Confuses powers or jurisdictions between different international or domestic organs (e.g. UN General Assembly vs Security Council, Planning Commission vs NITI Aayog).

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option 'Banning all regional languages and enforcing a single dialect'. Attributes a political stance, manifesto promise, or slogan to the wrong party or political faction.

detailedSolution:
The first and most immediate challenge immediately after independence was to shape a nation that was united yet deeply appreciative and accommodating of India's linguistic, regional, and cultural diversity.
